name: future-poland-rag-benchmark
description: The future-poland-rag-benchmark is a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) evaluation suite focused on questions about Poland's future (policy, economics, demographics, etc.), designed to test retrieval quality plus factual answer generation. It assesses whether RAG systems retrieve relevant evidence and produce accurate, well-grounded responses.
reputation: A small, domain-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited visibility outside niche RAG experiments.
